title: Coronary Computed Tomography Angiography (CCTA)
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for coronary computed tomography angiography (NCD 220.1). Requires stable chest pain syndrome with intermediate pre-test probability of CAD, able to achieve target resting heart rate < 65 bpm with oral/IV beta-blockers, and absence of extensive coronary calcification (Agatston score > 1000).

criteria.name: Intermediate CAD Probability and Target Heart Rate (< 65 bpm)
criteria.description: Documented intermediate pre-test probability of obstructive CAD, sinus rhythm, and target heart rate < 65 bpm achievable for high image quality.
criteria.clinical_intent: Ensure clinical pre-test probability and technical diagnostic quality
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Current available body of evidence demonstrates that CCTA can reliably rule out the presence of significant coronary artery disease (CAD) in patients with a low to intermediate probability of having CAD and can reliably achieve a high degree of diagnostic accuracy and technical performance necessary to replace conventional angiography.

criteria.name: Inconclusive Prior Stress Testing or Equivocal Biomarkers
criteria.description: Documented equivocal, inconclusive, or discordant prior stress ECG / stress echocardiogram, or inability to perform physical treadmill exercise.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Patients with known disease may have had remote invasive angiography and/or stress testing to evaluate prior events or symptoms.

criteria.name: Severe Tachyarrhythmia or Severe Renal Impairment Exclusion
criteria.description: Severe uncontrolled atrial fibrillation, irregular ventricular tachycardia, or severe renal dysfunction (eGFR < 30 mL/min).
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude non-diagnostic motion artifact or contrast nephropathy risk
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Pulmonary vein catheter ablation can isolate electrical activity from the pulmonary veins and allow for the elimination of recurrent atrial fibrillation.

cms_reference.notes: Verified from official CMS Coverage API /v1/data/lcd?lcdid=33947. Replaces MISMATCH (previously cited NCD 227 was Hospital Beds).
